topic: Heated Air Behavior and Atmospheric Phenomena
key_concepts: Warm air is less dense than cold air and rises
Cool air is denser and sinks
Unequal heating of Earth's surface causes air pressure differences
Wind is air moving from high-pressure to low-pressure areas
Heated air expands and its density decreases
Air temperature and density are inversely related
Surrounding air moves toward the area where warm air rises
Sand heats up and cools down faster than water
Land breezes and sea breezes result from unequal heating of land and water
Monsoons are large-scale seasonal wind systems caused by temperature differences
The Intertropical Convergence Zone is a low-pressure belt where trade winds meet
Rising warm air can be observed through simple models such as a paper bag over a candle
